name: Release
description: Cutting a Substrate release: promote the `dev` branch to `main` plus a version tag. **This is the ONLY flow that touches `main`.** A release candidate moves Ready → Docs Verified → Versioned → Validated → Approved → Released. Each gate carries the guideline for that step (doc verification, version bump, validation, tagging). Full runbook: RELEASING.md.

groups.name: Ready
groups.description: A release is proposed. Record the target `version` (vX.Y.Z; 0.x → minor for features, patch for fixes) and, in `changes`, what has landed on `dev` since the last tag.

groups.name: Docs Verified
groups.description: Documentation has been audited against the code and synced. See the gate for the checklist.

groups.name: Versioned
groups.description: Version bumped in all three sites and the CHANGELOG rotated (via `pnpm release`).

groups.name: Validated
groups.description: Full local validation is green (CI is billing-blocked).

groups.name: Approved
groups.description: Diego has signed off on cutting the release (dev → main + tag).

groups.name: Released
groups.description: Tagged, `dev` merged to `main`, pushed, and the global binary reinstalled.

policies.name: Verify documentation before versioning
policies.description: Docs must be audited against the code and synced before the version is cut.

definition.on_failure_message: Set docs_verified=true only after an audit against the CODE confirms: README tool count + command list match the registry/CLI; prd.md has no claim contradicting shipped behavior (operators, error codes, tools, version_mismatch); SKILL.md + AUTHORING.md counts/flows are current; and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has an entry for every user-facing change since the last tag. Prefer an independent audit agent that cross-checks docs vs code.

policies.name: Bump the version + rotate the CHANGELOG
policies.description: Version must be bumped in all three lockstep sites and the CHANGELOG rotated.

definition.on_failure_message: Set version_bumped=true after `pnpm release <spec>` bumps the THREE version sites in lockstep — package.json, ui/package.json, src/core/version.ts (BINARY_VERSION) — and renames CHANGELOG `## [Unreleased]` → `## [x.y.z] - <date>` with a fresh empty [Unreleased] above. See RELEASING.md.

policies.name: Validate before approval
policies.description: Full local validation must pass before the release is offered to Diego.

definition.on_failure_message: Set validated=true only after build + tsc + lint + format + all tests pass locally on the release commit (CI is billing-blocked, so local is the gate). `pnpm release --tag` re-runs these.

policies.name: Diego approves the release
policies.description: The human-only release gate. An agent cannot promote to main; Diego signs off.

definition.on_failure_message: Diego must approve cutting the release (dev → main + tag) — run `substrate approve <task_id> release_approved`. An agent cannot set this field.

policies.name: Tag, merge to main, reinstall
policies.description: The mechanical release steps must be done before the task is Released.

definition.on_failure_message: Set tagged=true after: `git tag vX.Y.Z` on the release commit + push the tag; merge `dev` → `main` and push; then rebuild + reinstall the global binary (see RELEASING.md 'After a release').

policies.name: Documentation verification checklist
policies.description: Fires while a release candidate is in Ready — the doc audit to run before versioning.

definition.message: Before versioning, verify docs against the CODE (an independent audit agent is ideal): (1) README — tool count matches src/mcp/registry.ts, command list matches the CLI dispatcher/HELP; (2) prd.md — no claim contradicts shipped behavior (operator set vs operators.ts, error codes, read/write tool lists, version_mismatch/current_version); (3) SKILL.md + AUTHORING.md — tool counts and flows current; (4) CHANGELOG — a [Unreleased] entry exists for every user-facing change since the last tag. Fix every gap, then set docs_verified=true.

policies.name: Version + tag steps
policies.description: Fires while cutting the version — the lockstep sites and tagging steps.

definition.message: Release mechanics (RELEASING.md): version lives in THREE lockstep sites — package.json, ui/package.json, src/core/version.ts. Cut with `pnpm release <spec> --tag` from a clean tree (or `pnpm release <spec>` then run the printed git steps). Tags are `vX.Y.Z` (not the phase-NN dev tags). Then merge `dev` → `main`, push both, and reinstall the global binary.
